text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring 02:00 storage-controller flaps. Need clear owners + timelines for alert tuning, dedupe, and paging policy changes. I'll list proposed actions below, pls ack and add ETA.

aj: ack. I can run a backtest against recent metrics today and propose exact numbers.

sanjay: +1. also thinking we should suppress noisy hosts during nightly sweep window unless error rate is high. can own whitelist.

rachel: we should avoid masking real regressions. paging policy needs an escalation cooldown and a clear severity gate.

leo: paste current alert snippet so i can update in terraform?

maria: current rule (simplified):
```
alert: StorageIOHigh
expr: iowait_percent > 70
for: 1m
labels: { severity: page }
annotations: { runbook: "https://confluence/redwood/ops/storage-iowait" }
```
proposed changes: threshold -> 85, `for: 2m`, dedupe_by: `instance,job`, add `snooze_windows: ["01:30-03:30"]` (nightly sweep), and only page if `errors_count > 5 in 5m` OR `latency_ms > 500`. also add runbook link + checklist.

aj: plan: I'll run the 14-day backtest with rollup and false-positive count EOD today. if ok, deploy to staging tomorrow and monitor 48h. owner: @aj, ETA: deploy to staging by 1778060000 (tomorrow).

sanjay: I'll update the runbook to include the new snooze window and add a maintenance whitelist for hosts that get rotated nightly. owner: @sanjay, ETA: Thu COB.

rachel: will adjust pager rotation to reduce fatigue. propose: escalation cooldown = 30m for same service + skip primary page during scheduled sweep window unless severity=critical. owner: @rachel, ETA: Fri morning.

leo: I'll create a small noise-sweep job that dedupes and auto-closes duplicates every 10m (labels match on cluster+alertname). PR by Wed. owner: @leo, ETA: Wed.

ops-bot: Created task REM-234 in #incidents: "Alert tuning sweep for storage flaps" — assignees: aj, sanjay, rachel, leo.

maria: Summary/backstop: owners/timelines above. Follow-up check-in next Tuesday to review pages_per_24h, false-positive rate, and any missed regressions. Also note recurring pattern: weekly growth spikes Sunday-Mon AM — add an evaluation harness so tuning doesn't hide genuine regressions. owner: @maria, ETA: next Wed.

aj: i'll also add a dashboard metric `pages_per_24h` and `false_positives_14d` to the Console so we can quantify impact. ETA: Thu.

sanjay: :thumbsup:

rachel: thanks all — I'll schedule a canary rollout (5% traffic, 2h) in the Console once AJ posts staging results. link to draft plan: https://console/redwood/canary/plans/1234

maria: thanks team. I'll capture final rule + runbook snippet in Confluence after AJ posts test output. closing the loop here but please update REM-234 tasks as you make changes.
